name: roc_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing large directional mandates compress their order flow into 1-2 minute windows, creating 1-minute ROC readings that rank in the top or bottom decile of the index's own intraday ROC distribution. Unlike single-stock momentum spikes (news, block deals), NIFTY's ROC extremes are driven by multi-participant flow — FII, prop desks, and index arb simultaneously — that requires 30-90 additional seconds to fully absorb. We detect these bursts by z-scoring the current 1-minute ROC against a rolling 20-minute baseline (adapting to the session's volatility regime), then entering in the direction of the burst only when the index is already on the correct side of session VWAP and volume is elevated, confirming genuine institutional activity rather than illiquid drift.
core_signal_oneliner: 1-min ROC z-score exceeds 1.8 SD above its 20-min baseline with elevated volume and VWAP alignment, signaling a multi-participant institutional burst
